references.text: Penuel (Peniel) is the place where Jacob wrestled with God and received the name Israel. This is the same geographical location that Gideon visited.
Gideon also asked the men of Succoth for food, but they refused in the same way as the men of Penuel. This shows the parallel between the two cities' rejection.
Gideon returned to Succoth and punished them for their refusal, just as he had threatened Penuel.
Jeroboam built Penuel, which demonstrates the site's continued significance in Israel's history.
